title: アニメーション制作演習
subtitle: Animated-Movie Production
educationalGoal: Students learn the animation principle and how to create and express animations based on the principle. Specifically, they learn about apparent motion expressions and time-lapse animations on paper media that can be easily produce. Students will acquire basic skills in animation production.
advice: In the first half, students create a flip-book animation to understand the principles of animation. In the second half, as an integrated learning, students create animations that express movements by connecting frames taken with a digital camera. In this class, practice is the main part. In the second half, it will be produced by a group. In the practice of scan animations, it is preferable that image processing software (PhotoShop etc.) can be used. Time-lapse images are animated using Movie Maker or Giam. In order to create original, fun, and high quality animations, it is recommended that students watched many animations from the creator's point of view, such as “expression methods”, “screen composition”, and “color and form”.
requiredKnowledge: Freehand drawing skills is required. It is preferable that image processing software (PhotoShop etc.) can be used.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the animation principle.
Be able to create animation with paper media.

Be able to edit digital animation basically.
